name: focus_reach_entity_3blocks
about: A zombie 3.2 blocks ahead (box face plus 0.1 border at x = 11.9) in front of a stone face at x = 13 (4.3 blocks). 1.7.10 searches entities only within 3.0, so the click digs the stone (C07 start); 1.8.9 finds the zombie, turns the pick into a MISS (no C02, no C07, leftClickCounter = 10).
